1:27.targetText: Pure and undefiled religion before our God and Father is this: to care for orphans and widows in their distress, and to keep oneself from being polluted by the world.

groups.note: Actual aspilon is the unspotted/unstained adjective. BSB from-being-polluted verbalizes that negative property, without a printed Greek polluting/passive-be predicate.
Actual apo from marks separation from the world; English by recasts the world as the source of the pollution being avoided. The real source preposition remains apo, not a printed hypo agent phrase.
